---
title: "Cisplatin_Annotation"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2025-11-24"
output: html_document
    The script is used for the Cisplatin and control cell type annotation
    Three ways were used for the cell type annotation
    1. find anchors between reference and query
    2. manually annotation
    3. use scVI 
    
    reference genome: Mouse Kidney Atlas (MKA) & MKA-Extended: Single-cell and single-nucleus reference atlases of the mouse kidney
    
note: we have generated the preprocessed single cell object. The object includes general seurat pipelines : normalization, scaling, feature selection, clustering,and umap. Additional quality control, deboulets removing, batch effects were also used.
---

```{r}
##########################################################################
### step 1: read in the single cell object we preproceeded.
##########################################################################

scrna<- readRDS(paste0(Inputdir,"CisplatinVsVehicle_singlecell_doublet_harmony_v0618.RDS"))

# we subclustered the cluster 6

```

# #####################################################
# we used the reference dataset from MRT
# #####################################################
```{r}
# reference input
reference <- readRDS("/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/PIPseq/Results/Evaluation_V022723/CellEvaluation_Subclustering_V0803/AnnotationValidation/Mouse_ATLAS_reference.rds")
reference <- UpdateSeuratObject(reference)
# Variable features
reference <- FindVariableFeatures(reference, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 4000)
scrna <- FindVariableFeatures(scrna, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 4000)

# Intersect features
features <- intersect(VariableFeatures(reference), VariableFeatures(scrna))
length(features)  # should be > 500 ideally

# Transfer cell type labels
DefaultAssay(reference) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(scrna) <- "RNA"



# we used the find anchors between reference and query

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = reference,
                               query = scrna,
                               features = features,
                               dims = 1:30)


predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors,
                            refdata = reference$cell_type,  # column with known labels
                            dims = 1:30)

scrna <- AddMetaData(scrna, metadata = predictions)

scrna@meta.data %>% head()

# manually annotate the single cells

# we initially subset the cluster 6 
Idents(scrna) <- "seurat_clusters"
scrna<-FindSubCluster(scrna,cluster=c("6"),graph.name = "RNA_snn",subcluster.name = "Sub1", resolution = 0.3)
Idents(scrna) <- "Sub1"
scrna<-FindSubCluster(scrna,cluster=c("3"),graph.name = "RNA_snn",subcluster.name = "Sub2", resolution = 0.2)
scrna@meta.data %>% head()
Idents(scrna) <- "Sub2"
DimPlot(scrna,split.by = "DataSet", label = T)

```
# #####################################################
# we manually add the cell type name for each cluster
# #####################################################
```{r}
# Cell Type
FinalCluster<- as.character(levels(factor(scrna$Sub2)))
FinalCluster
CellType <- data.frame(cluster=FinalCluster , cell= FinalCluster)
CellType
# add the cluster name
#CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c(0,3,9,12,18,19),2] <- "Proximal tubule"

#CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c(0,3,9,12,18,19),2] <- "Proximal tubule"

# CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("0"),2] <- "Proximal tubule I"
# CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("9"),2] <- "Proximal tubule II"
# CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("12"),2] <- "Proximal tubule III"
# #CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("18"),2] <- "Proximal tubule IV"
# CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("19"),2] <- "Proximal tubule V"
# 
# 
# CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("18"),2] <- "Glomerular Endothelial Cell"
# 

CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("6_0","6_1"),2] <- "TAL" # Thick ascending limb of LOH"
CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("6_2"),2] <- "DCT" # Distal convoluted tubule
CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("11"),2] <- "DTL" # immune cells

CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("0","5","7","8","1","2","4","14"),2] <- "PT" #"Proximal tubule"
CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("12"),2] <- "IC" #"Intercalated cells"
CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("3_0","3_1"),2] <- "PC" # "Principal cells"

CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("3_2"),2] <- "CNT" # "Connecting tubule"


CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("15","9","10"),2] <- "END" # "Endothelium"
CellType[CellType$cluster %in% c("8","13"),2] <- "IMM" # immune cells


# add the cell types
scrna@meta.data$Raw_cell_type <- sapply(scrna@meta.data$Sub2, function(x){CellType[CellType$cluster %in% x,2]})
levels(factor(scrna@meta.data$Raw_cell_type))

Idents(scrna) <- "Raw_cell_type"

DimPlot(scrna, split.by = "DataSet", label = T)
Finalcelltypemarkers<- c("Lrp2","Slc34a1","Slc13a3", # Proximal tubule cells (PT)
                      "Slc12a3","Pvalb","Wnk1",# Distal connecting tublue (DCT)

                     "Umod","Slc12a1","Cldn10", # Thick ascending limb cells (TAL)
                      "Klk1","Slc8a1","Calb1", # Connecting tubule (CNT)
                     "Slc14a2","Fst","Bst1", # descending thin  limb cells (DTL)
                     #"Akr1b1","Sh3gl3","Prox1", # ascending thin limb cells (ATL)
                     #"Enox1","Thsd4", #Macula densa
                      "Aqp2","Hsd11b2","Scnn1g", # principal cells (PC)
                    "Atp6v1g3","Aqp6","Slc26a7", # Intercalated cells
                   # "Krt5","Upk1b","Krt14", # Urothelium
                    "Cdh5","Igfbp3","Pecam1", # Endothelium
                    "Col3a1","Fbn1","Lum","Col1a1", # Fibroblast
                    "Ireb2","Alas2", # Plasmacytoid dentritic cells
                    "S100a8","S100a9","Il1b", # Neutrophil
                    "C1qa","C1qb","Aif1", # Macrophage
                    "Cxcr6","Cd247","Cd3e", # T cells
                    "Igkc","Cd79a","Cd79b", # B cells
                    "Ccl5","Nkg7","Cd7" # NK/Cd8 cells
)

DPlots<- DotPlot(scrna, features =Finalcelltypemarkers)+RotatedAxis()
ggsave("Cisplatin_Vehicle_RawAnnotation.pdf", plot = DPlots, height = 4, width = 10)

# save the RDS file 
saveRDS(scrna, file = "Cisplatin_Vehicle_Raw_Predict_Annotation.RDS")
```
